contexts.text: (Celestial speech) cannot be adapted to any word in which there is anything which sounds harshly.
The speech of evil Genii is... inwardly harsh, because from... no affection. AC 8021.
The third (murmuring sound)... was harsh... this harshness turned about backwards and forwards, ...
This cold is what is meant by the gnashing of teeth.
The thought and the speech must agree... otherwise something discordant is felt, like a disagreeable harshness... AR 294.

Sometimes there have been with me those who grated their teeth... These have not only led an evil life, but have also confirmed themselves against the Divine... These grate their teeth when they speak.
From this it is evident what the gnashing of teeth is, with those who are in Hell. Illustrated.
Those instruments which produce a stridulous and discrete sound = spiritual Divine truths.
The speech of hypocrites... is heard as the grating of teeth...
On the gnashing of teeth. General article.

The gnashing of teeth is the continual disputing and fighting of falsities with each other... conjoined with contempt for others, enmity, ridicule, and reviling... These disputings and combats are heard... as the gnashings of teeth, and are also turned into gnashings of teeth when truth from Heaven flows in thither. In these Hells are all those who have acknowledged nature and denied the Divine... They are corporeal sensuous Spirits... hence all fallacies of the senses are truths to them, and from these they dispute. Hence it is that their disputings are heard as gnashings of teeth; for, in the Spiritual World, all falsities make a harsh noise; and the teeth correspond to the ultimate things in nature and with man...
I heard as it were a grating of teeth... TCR 460.
The disputing which was heard as a grating of teeth was from those who were in faith alone.

As these altercations in the Hells are heard outside of them as gratings of the teeth, which, regarded in themselves, are collisions of falsity and truth, it is evident what is meant by the gnashing of teeth. Illustrated. TCR 402:9.
I again heard a harsh noise, like that of two millstones in collision with each other. Explained.
The tone of a hypocrite's voice grates in the heavenly aura, like one tooth in collision with another.

A third kind succeeded... There was as it were a harsh sounding murmur... and this harsh noise turned about hither and thither... For a harsh noise is that of Truths which sway backwards and forwards by reasonings.
I heard their harsh sounding gyres.
(The speech of the preacher) is first like the grating of teeth, then it is like a grating noise in the abdomen.
The spiritual (infants) are Known by a kind of stridulous sound...
On the gnashing of teeth. SE 4351.
With those who are in faith alone, and who dispute from falsities, there is the gnashing of teeth.
They came with a harsh sound...

By the gnashing of teeth in the Hells, is meant the continual disputing and combat of falsities with each other and against truths; thus of those who are in falsities, conjoined with contempt for others, etc... LJPost 32. LJPost 200. DeVerbo 6:2.
